_source: Contributors: the 10th, 11th and 2nd lords (BPHS tr. R. Santhanam, Vol. 1, Ch 24: 2nd lord vv. 13-24, 10th lord vv. 109-120, 11th lord vv. 121-132, verse = 12*(H-1)+n) and the planets in the 2nd and 11th. A lord's source type follows the house it occupies; that house-to-type table is an interpretive mapping from the house significations (BPHS Ch 11 vv. 2-13; see houses.json) and the Ch 24 results, not a classical table. A planet's type follows its significations (Phaladeepika tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Ch 2 vv. 1-7 and 17-20); Rahu and Ketu: popular tradition. Earning away from the native place: Phaladeepika Ch 5 v. 9. Sources are ranked by the contributing planets' planet_strength score (highest first), ties broken by Graha order, then type key.
